stories.title: Perfect time to explore the Pleiades star cluster
stories.description: November offers an excellent opportunity for Saskatchewan residents to discover one of the night sky's most recognizable star clusters. The Pleiades, also known as the Seven Sisters or Messier 45, are particularly well positioned for observation throughout the month. The cluster can be spotted without a telescope, making it an appealing target for experienced astronomers and casual skywatchers alike. Finding the Seven Sisters The Pleiades are an open star cluster, meaning the stars formed together from the same cloud of gas and dust. The grouping is relatively easy to recognize as a compact collection of bright stars.
